fact: On 8 July 2024 the Ministry held the DigSMART graduation: the 2023 pilot enrolled 170 participants from six ministries and three departments, and the 2024 Scale-Up launched in February enrolled 830 participants from 42 MDAs with training centres in Accra, Sunyani and Bolgatanga.
title: MoCD holds 2024 DigSMART Graduation Ceremony
publisher: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
